messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Pricing und conditions of Shiny Server hosting?
parts:
We have not decided those parameters at all. Our focus is on the enterprise-class version of Shiny Server first, and then we'll start working on paid hosting. But in the meantime, it's probably a decent assumption that it will start out as being similar to Glimmer but not free.

If you have specific feature requests, feel free to let us know.

messages.subject: Re: Pricing und conditions of Shiny Server hosting?
parts:
Thanks a lot for getting back to me. If I had a couple of wishes, I'd wish for the following:

1) Secure access to shiny apps, i.e. only people with the right user credentials can see certain apps (ideally via OAuth 2.0)
2) HTTPS Requests to the shiny app and responses as JSON, so you can use the shiny app as a web service without the user interface - or is this already possible...?
3) Differentiated user permissions for each account with several users, i.e. one user has full admin rights, others can only access apps in their own folder - and these rights would be reflected in how RStudio functions as well. Or is this already possible...?

Thanks a lot and have a lovely weekend!

Ignacio
